name: BSP_XenonSystemManager_ResetSignInState
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall/__thiscall(ECX = the 0x3f0-byte XenonSystemManager), no stack args. XenonSystemManager  ChangeState To %d' through 004254b0, then sets +0x3b4 and +0x3b8 to 1. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_AUDIO_ONLINE.md; reports/app_init_audio_online.json.

name: BSP_XLiveSystem_Initialize
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Direct callee of BSP_Application_Initialize (0073d410); called at 0073dc7c after the window title is pushed through DAT_0109cf04 virtual slot 4. Reconstructed in packet app_init_audio_online. __thiscall(ECX = a 0x3f0-byte XenonSystemManager from operator new at 0073dc50), RET 8: the caller pushes 00735510 and 00735520, two 14-byte image stubs of the form 'PUSH 6|4; PUSH 0x8001; PUSH ECX; CALL 00a6d3f2; RET', which land in +0x20 and +0x24. Base ctor 00a3f530; vtable 00d2413c; +0x10 = 1; the sign-in and notification fields are zeroed. Logs ' ...  XenonSystemManager Start Initialization  ...' (00d2435c) through 004254b0, then builds a 28-byte XLIVE_INITIALIZE_INFO on the stack: +0x00 cbSize = 0x1c, +0x04 = 0, +0x08 = the D3D9 device from BSP_D3D9Renderer_GetDevice (00b1fef0) on DAT_00f8d394, +0x0c = DAT_00f8d394 + 0x1a28 (the present parameters inside the renderer), +0x10 = GetUserDefaultLangID as a WORD, +0x14 and +0x18 = 0. XLiveInitializeEx(&info, 0x20029900) at 00a40f46 and its HRESULT is discarded. Logs ' ...  XenonSystemManager XLiveInitialized  ...' (00d2432c); 00a4c250 on the sub-object at +0x3ac; XOnlineStartup; XWSAStartup(0x0202, WSADATA) with the returned low word checked byte by byte and XWSACleanup called unless it is exactly 2.2; XNetSetSystemLinkPort(XSocketNTOHS(0x0c02)), the Xbox LIVE system link port 3074 in network byte order; XNotifyCreateListener(qwAreas = 0x2f) into +0x1c, with ' ...  XenonSystemManager XNotifyCreateListener  ... SUCCEED ' (00d242ec) logged only when the handle is neither 0 nor -1. Ends with BSP_XenonSystemManager_ResetSignInState (00a40020) and one pump of the state machine at 00a409f0. xlive.dll is a plain static import, so there is no path in this routine for XLive being absent.
